Hi, I've started implementing the time functions, so the call to as.POSIXct
should work now.

If you want to load the ggplot2 package, you will just need to tell renjin
where to find it. Right now renjin can only use packages in the original
R-2.x format, so you can just add the path to your local R installation by
calling, for example, .libPaths("/home/alex/x86blah/2.12"), or just copy
the ggplot2 package into a folder in your classpath called
/r/library/ggplot2

As for read.csv, I'm afraid this hasn't been implemented at all yet, I will
probably look at JDBC connections before this.

Thanks for trying out renjin even at this early stage!
